notes:
Window growing past the screen

Cause: the “Running: gam …” line above Output didn’t wrap. A long command, like a Chromebook list with many fields, made the whole window that wide.
The status line: it now stays one line, ends in “…”, and shows the full command when you hover over it.
Output, Jobs and Dry run: long lines now wrap. In the Jobs list, long commands are shortened with “…” in the middle.
Safeguards: if the main window ever needs more room than it has, its content scrolls instead of the window growing. Any window or dialog that opens bigger than your screen is shrunk and moved so the title bar and close buttons always show.

Taskbar icon

Cause: every size inside the icon file was saved as PNG. Windows only reliably reads PNG for its largest (256 px) icon size, and the taskbar uses the smaller sizes, so it showed a broken image.
The icon file: I rebuilt it with standard bitmap images for the small sizes. There’s a small script, tools/make_ico.py, to rebuild it if you ever change the logo.
Every window: the sign-in window and dialogs now use the icon too, not just the main window.
Installer shortcuts: they’re now linked to the running app, so Windows groups the taskbar button with the GAMbit shortcut.
After installing: if Windows still shows the old icon, unpin and re-pin GAMbit; Windows sometimes keeps old icons cached.

Dark mode

Where: Settings & Updates → Appearance and safety → Colors: Light, Dark, or Same as Windows. It switches right away; a few lists pick up the new colors the next time they load.
Readable text: green, red and orange status text becomes a lighter shade of the same color, gray hints become a lighter gray, and yellow tip banners turn dark gold. The output log was already dark and stays the same.
